title: Web pre-aggregation INSERTs must not depend on objects that exist only on some data hosts
answers: Web analytics pre-aggregation job fails with Code: 36 Dictionary not found
Pre-aggregated web analytics tables stop getting fresh data
Why does get_team_filters use GLOBAL IN instead of dictHas or an inline IN list
body:
Symptom: The scheduled web analytics pre-aggregation job fails on every run and the pre-aggregated tables go stale. ClickHouse logs show `Code: 36 ... Dictionary not found` on some hosts.
Root cause: posthog/models/web_preaggregated/sql.py:get_team_filters used `dictHas('web_pre_aggregated_teams_dict', team_id)`. The distributed INSERT evaluates that on every data host, and a host added after the dictionary migrations lacks the dictionary. Retries cannot recover.
Fix pattern: Without explicit team_ids, filter with `team_id GLOBAL IN (SELECT team_id FROM web_pre_aggregated_teams FINAL WHERE version > 0)`. This is built from WEB_PRE_AGGREGATED_SELECTED_TEAMS_SQL in posthog/models/web_preaggregated/team_selection.py. GLOBAL IN runs the subquery once on the initiator, so data hosts need neither the table nor the dictionary.
Constraints: Do not inline the selected IDs as an `IN (...)` list, because it grows with the selection and can hit the ClickHouse query size limit. Explicit `team_ids` op config still inlines its short list. Nothing reads the dictionary now, so the team selection asset no longer runs SYSTEM RELOAD DICTIONARY.
applies: Web analytics pre-aggregation INSERT SQL and the team selection dagster asset (posthog/models/web_preaggregated, products/web_analytics/dags)

search: Web pre-aggregation INSERTs must not depend on objects like dictionaries that exist only on some data hosts; distributed INSERTs evaluating host-dependent objects fail on hosts lacking them. Symptom: scheduled job fails with `Code: 36 ... Dictionary not found` in ClickHouse logs. Fix: replace `dictHas('web_pre_aggregated_teams_dict', team_id)` in `posthog/models/web_preaggregated/sql.py:get_team_filters` with `team_id GLOBAL IN (SELECT team_id FROM web_pre_aggregated_teams FINAL WHERE version > 0)` from WEB_PRE_AGGREGATED_SELECTED_TEAMS_SQL, which runs the subquery once on the initiator. Do not inline selected IDs as `IN (...)` lists (grows with selection, hits query size limit). The team selection asset no longer runs SYSTEM RELOAD DICTIONARY since nothing reads the dictionary now. Applies to web analytics pre-aggregation INSERT SQL and team selection dagster asset.
